verdict.rationale: Steel documents its own Credentials API (steel-docs-15), so a first-party credential store exists, but the evidence is a single index-level mention with no detail on how stored credentials are used in logins. Auth-context reuse is an adjacent session-persistence feature and is not credited here. missing for 10: documentation that the agent completes logins automatically from stored credentials, TOTP/2FA challenge handling, explicit guarantees that secrets are never exposed to the model, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
